article.headline: South Dakota knocks off Utah Tech 74-73
article.description: — Josiah Dotzler had 19 points in South Dakota’s 74-73 win against Utah Tech on Sunday.
article.linkText: South Dakota knocks off Utah Tech 74-73

keywords: South Dakota Coyotes @ Utah Tech Trailblazers
article.story: SIOUX FALLS, S.D. -- — Josiah Dotzler had 19 points in South Dakota’s 74-73 win against Utah Tech on Sunday. Dotzler also contributed five assists for the Coyotes (3-5). Vince Buzelis scored 17 points and added eight rebounds. Stef van Bussel shot 6 of 9 from the field to finish with 13 points. Ethan Potter led the way for the Trailblazers (1-5) with 23 points, six rebounds, four assists and three blocks. Owen Mackay added 16 points for Utah Tech. Aris Rodriguez finished with 12 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
